name: io.github.sriram1983007-dev/sra-riskgate-mcp
title: SRA-RiskGate
description: Check stablecoin and x402 payments before an AI agent pays: approve, hold or reject.

environmentVariables.name: SRA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint serving SRA-RiskGate-4B (default: Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name on that endpoint (default: sriram1983007/sra-riskgate)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_MAX_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Rule ceiling in whole tokens of the stablecoin paid; larger payments are held (default: 1000)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_ALLOWED_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Stablecoins the payment checks may approve: USDC, USDT, USDB, USDG (comma-separated). Default: USDC only

environmentVariables.name: SRA_EXTRA_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: US-dollar stablecoins the SDK does not list, as JSON: [{"symbol", "chain_id", "contract", "decimals", "eip3009"}]. Enable payments in them with SRA_ALLOWED_TOKENS

environmentVariables.name: SRA_EXTRA_TOKENS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file in the SRA_EXTRA_TOKENS format

environmentVariables.name: SRA_KNOWN_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Verified payee addresses, comma-separated; payments to anyone else are held (default: check off)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_KNOWN_RECIPIENTS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with one verified payee address per line, added to SRA_KNOWN_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.name: SRA_BLOCKED_ADDRESSES
environmentVariables.description: Addresses to always reject, comma-separated

environmentVariables.name: SRA_BLOCKED_ADDRESSES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with one address to reject per line, added to SRA_BLOCKED_ADDRESSES

environmentVariables.name: SRA_MAX_AUTH_VALIDITY_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Longest an x402 authorization may stay valid before it is held (default: 3600)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the model endpoint, if it needs one

environmentVariables.name: SRA_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for the model (default: 120)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_DEPEG_HOLD_PCT
environmentVariables.description: Hold payments when USDC is this many percent off $1.00 (default: 1)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_DEPEG_REJECT_PCT
environmentVariables.description: Reject payments when USDC is this many percent off $1.00 (default: 5)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_MAX_GATEWAY_VALIDITY_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Longest a Circle Gateway batched payment may stay valid before it is held (default: 691200, 8 days)

environmentVariables.name: SRA_CIRCLE_WALLETS
environmentVariables.description: Circle Wallets the agent may use, as walletId=0xaddress pairs, comma-separated; any other wallet is held

environmentVariables.name: SRA_CIRCLE_USDC_TOKEN_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Circle token ids confirmed to be USDC, for transfers by tokenId, comma-separated

environmentVariables.name: SRA_EXPECTED_DELEGATES
environmentVariables.description: EIP-7702 delegate contracts your wallet uses on purpose, comma-separated; with account_code, any other delegation is held

environmentVariables.name: SRA_EXPECTED_DELEGATES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with one expected delegate address per line, added to SRA_EXPECTED_DELEGATES

environmentVariables.name: SRA_EXPECTED_PAYMASTERS
environmentVariables.description: Paymasters your smart account uses on purpose (comma/space separated). When set, a UserOperation with any other paymaster is held.

environmentVariables.name: SRA_EXPECTED_PAYMASTERS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with one expected paymaster address per line.

environmentVariables.name: SRA_EXPECTED_SPENDERS
environmentVariables.description: Contracts your wallet approved on purpose (comma/space separated). check_allowances holds an allowance to any other spender.

environmentVariables.name: SRA_EXPECTED_SPENDERS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File with one expected spender address per line.

environmentVariables.name: SRA_MAX_ALLOWANCE
environmentVariables.description: The most any one spender may be allowed, in whole tokens. check_allowances holds anything larger.

environmentVariables.name: SRA_ALLOW_ACCOUNT_DEPLOYMENT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow a UserOperation that also deploys the smart account (initCode/factory). Default: held.
